groups.comparison: Exact P16 combat1137, config122 and contact_timing57 read fully, including source tests without running them. Public AttackResult already owns attacker-versus-defender payload; ToAttacker physical_contact Boolean beside contact_force is a pending split between avoided and intercepted contact, requiring remaining melee-resolution producers. Positive force is NOT guaranteed by contact tag: ranged interception can retain zero scaled force. ToDefender armor impact None is a genuine coverage gap, not incomplete data. AttackResult scalar multiplication preserves impact classification while scaling energies; this materially qualifies F125: historical Penetrated may carry zero after legitimate zero scaling or underflow, so its earlier strictly-positive payload must not be imposed on all scaled observations. Public negative/nonfinite scalar multiplication is separate numeric invariant work, no ordinary failure claimed. DefenderResponse already owns Block effectiveness, Parry reflex/precision and Dodge reflex; independent reflex and precision must remain independent. Common energy and durable health damage are different provenance; exact damage apportionment uses weighted blunt contribution. Zero energy produces no effective contact in resolver, while armor-absorbed contact can retain positive stress with zero health damage. General starting condition removes recomputed pain/blood terms once. Configuration aggregates enforce additional positive/ordered bounds by explicit validate after field deserialization; no aggregate admission clearance is inferred from derives. ContactTimingOffset is signed finite difference with positive/later, negative/earlier and zero/simultaneous meanings, not a positive elapsed duration. Duration conversion is actual nonnegative authoritative clock adapter and preserves ordered subtraction elsewhere.
groups.disposition: F125 positivity qualification; existing response payloads and signed timing preserved

limits: Discovery only; no execution, fixes, checks, implementation plan or lens clearance.
